records.title: Sponsored Fees and Reserves — XLS-68 mechanics
records.summary: The Sponsor covers transaction fees and/or reserve requirements while the Sponsee retains control of its keys. Sponsorship does not transfer XRP to the Sponsee; the sponsor retains XRP and the ledger attributes the reserve obligation to the sponsor. Sponsorship requires the Sponsor amendment. The current account-creation special case is a Payment with tfSponsorCreatedAccount. The reserve formula shifts account reserve and sponsored-object reserve obligations to the sponsor. Ending object sponsorship requires the Sponsee to have sufficient XRP; the check requires fixCleanup3_4_0.
records.limitations: Documentation describes the feature and rules but does not establish Mainnet activation or production adoption. The Sponsor amendment status must be checked separately.

records.title: Vulnerability Disclosure Report: XLS-68 Sponsored Fees and Reserves
records.summary: A reserve-accounting vulnerability was reported 2026-08-07 during Devnet testing of Sponsor. The Sponsor amendment was not activated on Mainnet and no funds were at risk. The fix was released in xrpld v3.4.0 on 2026-09-17. The design adopts conditional sponsorship exit: the Sponsee must self-fund the reserve, another sponsor must assume it, or the sponsored object/account must be deleted. The docs say the object-reserve exit check requires fixCleanup3_4_0.
records.limitations: The disclosure is an official project report, not an independent security audit. The software fix release does not itself activate the fixCleanup3_4_0 or Sponsor amendments on Mainnet.
